text:
Predicates:
Infectious(x) ::: x is an infectious disease.
CausedBy(x, y) ::: x is caused by y.
OccursIn(x, y) ::: x occurs in y.
IsA(x, y) ::: x is a y.
Symptom(x, y) ::: x is a symptom of y.
Feel(x, y) ::: x feels y.
Premises:
Infectious(monkeypox) ∧ CausedBy(monkeypox, monkeypoxVirus) ::: Monkeypox is an infectious disease caused by the monkeypox virus.
OccursIn(monkeypoxVirus, animals) ∧ IsA(humans, mammals) ∧ IsA(mammals, animals) ::: Monkeypox virus can occur in certain animals, including humans. Humans are mammals. Mammals are animals.
Symptom(monkeypox, fever) ∧ Symptom(monkeypox, headache) ∧ Symptom(monkeypox, musclePains) ∧ Symptom(monkeypox, feelingTired) ::: Symptoms of Monkeypox include fever, headache, muscle pains, feeling tired, and so on.
Feel(people, tired) → Get(people, glu) ::: People feel tired when they get a glu.
Conclusion:
Symptom(monkeypox, coughing) ::: Symptoms of Monkeypox include coughing.
